title: [CON-2] `accessSig` and `billingSig` sign "the envelope with the signature omitted", which contrad
description: Review finding CON-2: `accessSig` and `billingSig` sign "the envelope with the signature omitted", which contradicts §13.1's no-canonical-form rule; the routing envelope field set is scattered (lens CON). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:206 (accessSig), :204 (billingSig), :196 (`id` is "CID of the canonical outer envelope"); spec/13-encoding.md:9, :27, :49; spec/11-transport.md:54 (relays accept JSON and CBOR), :236 (`pushUrgency`); spec/10-relays.md:676 (`powProof`); spec/05-messaging.md:138 (`broadcastPayload`). Fix: As the reviewer proposes. Write one normative `RoutingEnvelope` definition listing every member. Define `accessSig` over an explicit byte string, and state whether `powProof` and `pushUrgency` are covered. Make `accessKeyAnnouncement` a typed envelope with named members, signed with the previous access key, with `billingSig` as a §13.1.1 `sig` entry. Redefine `id` so it does not hash itself. All of this follows from D1/D6 (signatures over exact bytes, no canonicalization). Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
